# Purpose
This header defines a generated seccomp BPF policy for `fd_bank_tile`. It builds a `sock_filter` program that checks the runtime architecture and then allows only `write` and `fsync` system calls, with extra checks on file descriptor arguments. The `write` call is allowed only for standard error (`2`) or for the `logfile_fd` value passed into [`populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_bank_tile`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_bank_tile>), and `fsync` is allowed only for `logfile_fd`. All other system calls, or calls that do not match these rules, end with `SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS`.
